name: Movilnet Omnicanal — Pasarela Financiera Pago Móvil C2P

parameters.pythonCode:
# Validación Previa y Formateo C2P
data = _input.first().json
ref_id = str(data.get('reference_id', '')).strip()
phone = str(data.get('msisdn', '')).strip()
bank = str(data.get('bank_code', '0102')).strip()
amount = float(data.get('amount_ves', 0.0))
cid = str(data.get('payer_cid', '')).strip()
otp = str(data.get('otp_token', '')).strip()

return {
    'reference_id': ref_id,
    'msisdn': phone,
    'bank_code': bank,
    'amount_ves': amount,
    'payer_cid': cid,
    'otp_token': otp,
    'validated_precheck': bool(ref_id and phone and amount > 0 and otp),
    'timestamp': $now.toISO()
}

# Generador de Recibo Digital Fiscal Movilnet
res = _input.first().json
ref = res.get('reference_id', 'REF-000000')
msisdn = res.get('msisdn', 'Línea')
bank = res.get('bank_name', 'Institución Bancaria')
amount_ves = res.get('amount_ves', 0.0)
amount_usd = res.get('amount_usd', 0.0)
new_bal = res.get('new_balance_ves', 0.0)
exec_at = res.get('executed_at', $now.toISO())

receipt = (
    f"🧾 *COMPROBANTE DE RECARGA EXITOSA* 🧾\n"\
    f"*Telecomunicaciones Movilnet C.A.*\n\n"\
    f"🔹 *Referencia:* `{ref}`\n"\
    f"🔹 *Línea Beneficiaria:* `{msisdn}`\n"\
    f"🔹 *Banco Origen:* {bank}\n"\
    f"🔹 *Monto Acreditado:* Bs. {amount_ves:,.2f} (~${amount_usd:.2f} USD)\n"\
    f"🔹 *Nuevo Saldo Disponible:* Bs. {new_bal:,.2f}\n"\
    f"🔹 *Fecha y Hora:* {exec_at}\n\n"\
    f"_¡Gracias por mantenerte conectado con la señal 4GMAX de Movilnet!_"
)

return {
    'receipt_text': receipt,
    'reference_id': ref,
    'status': 'APROBADO_CONCILIADO'
}
